body:
Yahoo Sports reports that Cowboys fans are livid, shouting "Shut Up" and "Stop Taking Bullets for Him" as Dak Prescott shields coach Brian Schottenheimer following an overtime loss to the Cardinals.

In contrast, the Dallas Cowboys official site notes that Dak Prescott himself described the loss to the Cardinals as "one of the toughest" in his career.
headline: Fans livid over Dak Prescott shielding coach after OT loss
